worldcombat.skill.acid.summary: Lob a glob of harsh acid: it bursts beside the target and splashes every enemy around the landing spot, then leaves a corrosive pool on the ground that keeps biting anyone who stays. On hit it may lower the target's Sp. Def by 1 stage.
worldcombat.skill.acid.use.0: Splash everyone around a landing spot at close range
worldcombat.skill.acid.use.1: Leave a lingering pool to lock down a patch of ground
worldcombat.skill.acid.use.2: Wear down Sp. Def with the cheapest cast
worldcombat.skill.acid.description.0: The burst deals %1$s special damage to every enemy around the landing spot.
worldcombat.skill.acid.description.1: The acid covers a radius of %1$s blocks around the landing spot.
worldcombat.skill.acid.description.2: The pool left behind deals %1$s damage per tick for %2$s, biting once every %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.acid.description.3: On hit there is a %1$s chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by %2$s stage(s); corrode form is currently %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.acid.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.acid.growth.0: From level %1$s the splash rises to %2$s power and the pool to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.acid.preference.corrod: On: pool radius ×1.25, duration +30 ticks, each tick ×1.4, +1 tick wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown, but the burst ×0.85 — good for locking ground down. Off: a harder burst and a smaller pool for hurting a group.
worldcombat.skill.acid.preference.ai.max: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values let it open with acid from further away.
worldcombat.skill.acid.preference.ai.cro: On: when other enemies stand within 3 blocks of the target it prefers acid, so the splash and pool bite more. Off: it sorts like an ordinary close-range attack.
